title: Microsoft rolls out a Xbox PC app with an overhauled design to Xbox Insiders that it says launches up to 60% faster than before (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Microsoft rolls out a Xbox PC app with an overhauled design to Xbox Insiders that it says launches up to 60% faster than before — Xbox Insiders can start testing the new PC app today. … Microsoft is unveiling a new Xbox PC app that launches “up to 60 percent faster” than before …
contentText:
Tom Warren / The Verge :

Microsoft rolls out a Xbox PC app with an overhauled design to Xbox Insiders that it says launches up to 60% faster than before   —  Xbox Insiders can start testing the new PC app today. … Microsoft is unveiling a new Xbox PC app that launches “up to 60 percent faster” than before …
